lines.text: Assemble builds on the grid. Diamond uses four points.
Box and Merged add the corners. Center adds the middle.
Tap a point to place the left hand.
The chips above set its orientation and turns.
Each tap moves the hand to the next point.
The app writes the motion for you.
Three steps for the left hand so far.
Switch hands. The left hand's path stays as a ghost.
The right hand gets its own start point.
Steps pair up. Each pair is one pictograph in the workspace.
Turns and direction apply to the next step.

lines.click: Turn count and rotation direction"] button #4
lines.text: One turn on the way to the next point.

lines.click: Turn count and rotation direction"] button #1
lines.text: CCW spins it the other way.
The step shows the turn in its notation.
Complete locks the sequence and shows the end poses.
Play opens the viewer with the animation.
Save keeps it in your library.
